title: Father as a school principal raising money from gamblers
summary: His father was principal at a Louisiana school and got money from madams, pimps and dice games, who gave him cuts.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: So my dad also was the principal of a high school, I think, of a place called Boagaloosa, Louisiana. Now I don't even know how to spell that -- I may not even be pronouncing it right.

Boogaloosa? Okay, that's ... but when you hear those types of words when you're a kid, you say it the way it sounds to you, and I always thought it was B-u-g, you know? I don't know. But he was principal of a school there, and you know, things don't change as much as we think they do, I guess, because he said when he used to try to get money to build things for the school, and the places he had to go to get this money, it seems as though it would always

be -- he would have to go to the hustling people, you know, like the Madams and the pimps, and the places where they were gambling. He said they had this place where they used to shoot dice and play cards, and he would go in and say that he needed something for the school, and the guy that was running the crap game or something, would say, "Well, when the craps go around and get back to me, Professor Young gets all the cuts off this."
